info.title: Logistics CEO Agent - Enterprise Source of Truth API
info.description: The definitive operational source of truth and autonomous AI tool-calling REST API for the Logistics Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Agent. Powers all 10 core logistics entities (Users, Companies, Drivers, Vehicles, Orders, Shipments, Deliveries, Routes, Warehouses, Customers) with executive telemetry and tool actions.
